profile_text.body:
Lokalise is a continuous localization and translation management platform, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Newark, Delaware, USA. The company describes the product as integrating into a development workflow so teams can ship localized products faster, and as bringing localization into one system that connects workflows, standardizes execution, and uses AI to produce consistent, on-brand results in every market.

Its tracked product is Lokalise AI, described as localization AI for continuous translation and developer workflow, hosted in the UK. According to the company, the AI applies approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary; Custom AI Profiles, surrounding context, and metadata supply the context needed for accurate translations; and AI Scoring evaluates translation quality automatically so that only low-confidence results require human review. The platform dynamically selects and routes to the best-fit LLM based on language, content, and context, and role-based access control applies across both the platform and its API. The company has also published a comparison of ten AI translation tools, stating that such tools cannot fully replace human translators but can save time and effort.

Delaware is listed as a jurisdiction of legal exposure with a count of 24, and no individual cases are named. No MCP servers are recorded for the company.
